original_snippet:
if current_time > coupon.expires_at:
        raise ExpiredCouponError(f"Coupon {coupon.code} expired at {coupon.expires_at}")
description: Remove the expiry guard from apply_coupon
expected_violation: An expired coupon is applied to the total instead of being rejected
violation_scenario: apply_coupon(100.0, Coupon(code='SAVE20', discount_percent=20.0, expires_at=datetime(2020,1,1)), datetime(2026,1,1)) returns 80.0 instead of raising.
rationale: Deleting the two guard lines is the smallest plausible change that lets an expired coupon be applied.
